title: Desk Rule Note — Deposits, Tenders and Payment Limits on Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Rule.** The deposit due when a Ridgeline Special Order Services order is placed is the greater of the program's minimum deposit and the program's deposit percentage of the order total, that percentage rounded to the cent, and it is never more than the order total. The remaining balance is due before the item is released for pickup or delivery. Payments are accepted on orders whose status is placed, vendor confirmed, in production, shipped or ready. The tender must be one of the program's accepted tenders; a payment charged to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account posts as a purchase on that account, and one charged to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account posts as an invoice. A payment may not exceed the order's balance due.

**Evidence for the status condition.** The status is the one shown on the special order record to which the payment is applied, as it stands before the payment.

**The balance due** is the amount the customer owes on the order: the order total, fees and refunds paid out raise it; payments and credits lower it; a negative balance due means money is owed back to the customer.

## Status check

| Order status | Payment accepted |
|---|---|
| placed, vendor confirmed, in production, shipped, ready | yes |
| completed, cancelled, returned | no — not among the statuses on which payments are accepted |

## Worked deposits (hypothetical order totals, program figures from the program schedule)

| Program | Order total | Percentage part | Minimum deposit | Deposit due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windows and Exterior Doors (50 percent, minimum 250.00) | 420.00 | 210.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 |
| Semi-Custom Cabinetry (50 percent, minimum 500.00) | 2400.00 | 1200.00 | 500.00 | 1200.00 |
| Fabricated Countertops (50 percent, minimum 500.00) | 900.00 | 450.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Catalog Merchandise (100 percent, minimum 0.00) | 60.00 | 60.00 | 0.00 | 60.00 |

## Points of judgement

- On the hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry order above, once the 1200.00 deposit is paid the balance due is 1200.00 and must be paid before release; a single payment of 1500.00 would exceed the balance due and is not accepted.
- A payment by Ridgeline Pro Credit appears on the customer's Pro Credit account as an invoice; one by Ridgeline Consumer Credit appears as a purchase on the card account.
